updates.new_result: RAKL now has support-only path certificates separating NAVIGABLE_ONLY from COMPOSABLE_TRANSFER_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY. End-to-end transfer requires valid local witnesses, exact junction identity, compatible shared-node roles, fixed QoI in v1, invariant continuity, non-empty full-path regime intersection, evidence lineage, and certified error-composition semantics. The support layer cannot mint an endpoint relation or target authority.
updates.same_round_residual: The first implementation generically summed hop error values. Fresh compositional-abstraction-error literature showed this was not justified for arbitrary divergences, so an immutable benchmark addendum was frozen and the implementation was corrected to require a predeclared composition rule for one declared error semantics.
updates.remaining_gap: No real scientific multi-hop bridge benchmark has yet measured whether the richer path certificate improves transfer precision or failure localization over pairwise-only validation.

updates.problem: Synthetic hostile worlds establish contract behavior but do not show that explicit path certificates improve real cross-domain scientific discovery or transfer.
updates.target: Freeze real A-B-C scientific bridge packets with expert-validated useful bridges, changing invariants, near-miss intermediate identities/roles, regime mismatches, mixed relation classes, correlated evidence ancestry and target tests; compare pairwise-only validation against full path certification under the same model, corpus, resources, evaluator and budget.
updates.falsifier: If pairwise-only validation matches the full certificate on valid-target-transfer precision, failure localization and authority leakage at lower cost, keep BRIDGE_TO as simpler navigation and do not activate richer path composition.

updates.new_prior: Fresh multi-hop literature reports a depth/diversity versus grounding-stability trade-off, so path depth should remain one Pareto coordinate rather than a reward by itself.

new_prior_art: causal and compositional abstraction as natural transformations
updates.consequence: Do not claim multi-hop bridge search, compositional analogy, category-theoretic analogy or compositional abstraction error individually. Any RAKL contribution claim remains at the narrower typed evidence-governance and authority-boundary level.
